answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 351 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the pigment. The grove index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the copper queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. A farm of 173 pays that 189 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
